name: pd_service_update
description: Update an existing service's name, description, state, or escalation policy (PUT /services/{id})

id.description: The ID of the service to update.

description.description: The user-provided description of the service.

status.description: The current state of the service. One of: active, warning, critical, maintenance, disabled.

escalation_policy_id.description: The ID of the escalation policy used by this service (service.escalation_policy.id).
